---
title: "02_plate_assignments"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```


# Import list of samples

```{r}
data <- read_rds(here::here("data","derived","run_001_sample_list.rds"))
```

# Assign plates

94 samples are assigned per plate to allow for a PCR1 blank and a PCR2 blank per plate. Note samples are assigned to plates based on their order in the sample_list.

```{r}
# this is just for example, don't need to do this normally because it would be done already
plates <- data %>%
    #arrange(project_id) %>%
    mutate(
    plate_num = ((row_number() - 1) %/% 94) + 1
  ) %>% 
  select(ind_id, tube_id, project_id, ploidy, sample_descr, sample_type, extr_method, plate_num, note) 
```

# Save plate assignments

```{r}
write_rds(plates, here::here("data","derived","run_001_plate_assignments.rds"))
```
